title: Sing We Owls
program_note:
In anticipation of a tour of Taiwan with the Glory Star Children’s Choir, in which the choir was singing my Prayer Before Sleep, I wrote this simple piece for them to sing as well, with the following text:

Hoot! Hoot! Hoot!, of owls we sing,

sweet owls, soft owls sing Hoot! Hoot! Hoot!

Hoot! Hoot! Hoot! sing owls sing all night long

Heads turn eyes show moonlit nights

Nights moonlit show eyes, turn heads,

Long night all sing —owls sing— Hoot! Hoot! Hoot!

Hoot! Hoot! Hoot! sing owls, soft owls sweet,

Sing we owls of Hoot! Hoot! Hoot!
